homeAffordability.formula: Max housing ≤ income × DTI − other debts; loan ← reverse amortization
homeAffordability.summary: Backs into an affordable purchase/loan from income and debt-to-income limits.

propertyTax.summary: Estimates annual property tax from assessed value and local rate.

rentalCashFlow.formula: Cash flow = Rent − (mortgage + tax + insurance + ops + vacancy)

capRate.summary: Unlevered yield on an income property using net operating income.
notes: Ignores financing—use cash-on-cash for levered views.

grossRentMultiplier.summary: Quick valuation multiple relating price to gross rents (before expenses).
notes: Lower GRM can mean cheaper relative to rents—compare comps carefully.

homeImprovementRoi.summary: Rough return on a renovation from cost versus estimated value added.

downPaymentTimeline.formula: Months ≈ iterate savings until down-payment target
downPaymentTimeline.summary: Projects how long to accumulate a down payment at your savings rate.

closingCosts.formula: Total closing ≈ Σ fees + points + prepaid items
closingCosts.summary: Adds typical buyer/seller closing line items into an all-in estimate.

compoundInterest.summary: Future value of principal plus recurring contributions with compounding. Optional coasting years grow without new deposits.
notes: Assumes constant rate and uninterrupted contributions.

fireRetirement.summary: Nest egg needed so a chosen withdrawal rate covers annual spending.
notes: Historical SWRs are guidelines, not guarantees.

retirementGoal.formula: Required PMT from FV annuity formula solving for payment
retirementGoal.summary: Backs into the savings rate needed to reach a retirement nest-egg target.
notes: Inflation and sequence-of-returns risk are not fully modeled.

rrsp401kGrowth.summary: Projects tax-advantaged account growth from balance, contributions, and assumed return.

dividendReinvestment.formula: Shares grow via DRIP: dividends buy more shares each period
dividendReinvestment.summary: Models share count and value when dividends are reinvested rather than taken as cash.

inflationPurchasingPower.summary: Shows how inflation erodes the buying power of a nominal amount over time.

netWorthTracker.formula: Net worth = Total assets − Total liabilities
netWorthTracker.summary: Simple balance-sheet snapshot of what you own minus what you owe.

ruleOf72.summary: Fast mental estimate of doubling time at constant annual return r (%).

dollarCostAveraging.formula: Avg cost = total invested / shares accumulated across periods
dollarCostAveraging.summary: Spreads purchases over time to average entry price rather than timing a lump sum.

feeImpact.summary: Quantifies how annual expense ratios drag long-term portfolio value.

freelanceHourlyRate.summary: Backs into an hourly rate that covers income goals, overhead, and non-billable time.

takeHomePay.summary: Simplified estimate of paycheck net after an effective tax/withholding rate.

selfEmploymentTax.formula: SE tax ≈ taxableSE × combined OASDI/Medicare rate (simplified)

salaryToHourly.summary: Converts salary to an equivalent hourly rate for a chosen work-year.

overtimePay.summary: Computes overtime earnings from hours above standard at a multiplier (often 1.5×).

salaryRaise.formula: New = Old × (1 + raise%)    ·    Δ = New − Old

salesCommission.summary: Combines base pay with variable commission on sales volume.

sideHustleProfit.summary: Estimates side-income profit after costs and a simplified tax bite.

expenseTracker.summary: Your running balance is the sum of all income transactions minus the sum of all expense transactions stored in this browser. Each row is an immutable ledger entry until you delete it.

variables.description: Sum of all transactions marked as income (paychecks, freelance, transfers in).

variables.name: Total expenses
variables.description: Sum of all transactions marked as expense (bills, food, shopping, etc.).

variables.name: Net balance
variables.description: Income minus expenses—positive means surplus, negative means overspending in the logged period.

variables.description: Groups transactions for filtering (Food, Transport, Salary, and more).
